literal_meaning: একই ক্ষুর দিয়ে মাথা কামানো (shaving the head with a single razor)
figurative_meaning_en: Of the same lineage or clan; belonging to the same group; everyone in agreement; of similar nature
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের সবাই একক্ষুরে মাথা কামানোর মতো একমত হয়ে উঠলো।
এই দুই ভাই একক্ষুরে মাথা কামানোর মতো একই গোষ্ঠীর লোক।
example_sentences_in_english: The whole village became unanimous like shaving heads with a single razor.
These two brothers are from the same clan, like heads shaved with one razor.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali practices where members of the same gotra or family would shave their heads together during rituals or mourning, symbolizing unity.
note: The idiom emphasizes collective identity and harmony in group settings.
